t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2016, a temporary building that has since been taken down. It was designed by Bjarke Ingels, the Danish architect who founded and leads Bjarke Ingels Group, known as BIG. Beyond that, little is recorded here, so there is not much more to say about the structure itself. What you see now is the space where the pavilion once stood.
